text: 美国7月商品贸易逆差扩大至去年年初以来最高水平，资本设备进口大幅飙升。 美国商务部周四公布的数据显示，7月商品贸易逆差较上月扩大17.2%，至1,188亿美元，为2025年3月以来最大。彭博调查的经济学家预估中值为逆差1,005亿美元。上述数据未经通胀调整。 美国7月商品进口增长3.7%，其中资本品进口创1993年以来最大增幅，资本品包括电脑及配件、半导体和电信设备。商品出口下降2.9%。
text_en: The US goods trade deficit widened in July to its highest level since early last year, with a sharp surge in capital equipment imports. Data released Thursday by the Commerce Department showed the goods trade deficit expanded 17.2% from the prior month to $118.8 billion, the largest since March 2025. The median estimate in a Bloomberg survey of economists was for a deficit of $100.5 billion. The figures are not inflation-adjusted. US goods imports rose 3.7% in July, with capital goods imports posting their biggest gain since 1993, including computers and accessories, semiconductors, and telecom equipment. Goods exports fell 2.9%.
